remarks:
Discover exceptional privacy & space at 8590 Northfield, beautifully situated on a magnificent 4.03-acre property surrounded by mature trees and peaceful natural beauty. A sweeping curved concrete driveway & impressive front entrance welcome you to this spacious home offering over 2,800 square feet of living space.
Inside, you'll find fresh paint throughout, new carpeting, beautiful hardwood floors, & rich natural wood doors that add warmth & character. The main living area flows seamlessly from living room to kitchen in a fully open concept making the space feel both expansive and connected, anchored by soaring vaulted ceilings in the kitchen that add light. The expansive 1st-floor primary suite features elevated ceilings that lend the room a spacious, airy feel, while the ensuite bath impresses with its own vaulted ceiling — a detail that elevates the everyday. The walk-in closet & ease of 1st-floor living complete the package. Adjacent to the primary suite, a distinguished private office with custom built-in wood shelving & French doors creates an ideal workspace that is both functional & impressive. The inviting interior also features a wood-burning stove — a true centerpiece for cozy evenings — along with a spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances and distinctive granite countertops. Upstairs, a cozy loft, 3 additional bedrooms, & a full bath round out the upper level beautifully.
Step outside onto the Trex deck with retractable awning and experience what true privacy feels like — a fully wooded backyard where not a single neighbor is visible. This is the kind of quiet that's genuinely hard to find. Yet you're right in the heart of Clarence, in the highly regarded Clarence School District, w/ quick access to the 290 & just 30 mins. from Downtown Buffalo. The best of both worlds: peaceful seclusion without sacrificing convenience.
Properties that offer this level of privacy w/o trading away location, schools, or convenience — are genuinely rare in Western New York.
An additional 1.9-acre buildable lot is available for separate purchase, offering the opportunity to expand the estate to nearly 6 acres — more land, more privacy, more possibility.
